conflict resolution strategies are linked to group outcomes.
teams that maintain top performance are likely to: (a) focus on content, not delivery, (b) discuss reasons behind any decisions made, and (c ) assign work based on expertise rather than convenience.

teams that are able to maintain or improve top performance over time are likely both to be proactive in anticipating conflict and to use a pluralistic set of conflict management strategies that are effective for all group members.

understanding the relationship between conflict and team performance.
the role of conflict resolution strategies in the success of autonomous work teams.
the question of how groups resolve conflict in ways that enhance performance and satisfaction over time.

the most effective teams are those that are able to manage their conflicts in an effective way.

the more the team uses conflict resolution strategies, the better its performance and satisfaction.

the most successful conflict resolution strategies are those that are both proactive and pluralistic.
